nodes.name: accordion.css
nodes.summary: Styles the accordion component's items, headers, triggers, and collapsible content, with slideDown/slideUp keyframe animations for open and close transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the [data-component]/[data-slot] attribute-selector convention and native CSS nesting.

nodes.name: animated-number.css
nodes.summary: Styles the rolling-digit animated number display using per-digit strips and cells, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback that disables the roll animation.

nodes.name: app-icon.css
nodes.summary: Minimal styles for the app icon image element, enforcing block display, border-box sizing, and contain object-fit.

nodes.name: avatar.css
nodes.summary: Styles user avatars with an info-tinted monogram fallback (mono font, uppercase) exposed via --avatar-bg/--avatar-fg tokens, small/normal/large size variants, and a borderless full-bleed image mode.

nodes.name: basic-tool.css
nodes.summary: Styles the generic tool-call card rendered for assistant tool invocations, covering the trigger row, spinner, title/subtitle, structured argument sections, and nested task-tool sub-cards.

nodes.name: button.css
nodes.summary: Styles the shared button component's variants with focus rings, size handling, and icon-slot alignment for the Kobalte-based SolidJS wrapper.

nodes.name: card.css
nodes.summary: Styles the card container with spacing and layout custom properties (--card-pad-*, --card-indent, --card-accent) plus title, description, actions, and title-icon slots.

nodes.name: checkbox.css
nodes.summary: Styles the form checkbox: visually hidden native input, custom control box with animated indicator, label, description, and error states.

nodes.name: collapsible.css
nodes.summary: Styles the collapsible disclosure widget with a rotating arrow trigger and slideDown/slideUp animated content region.

nodes.name: context-menu.css
nodes.summary: Styles the right-click context menu: animated content popover, items with indicators/labels/descriptions, separators, group labels, checkbox and radio items, sub-triggers, and arrow.

nodes.name: dialog.css
nodes.summary: Styles the modal dialog with separate overlay and content show/hide keyframes, plus container, header, title, description, body, and close-button slots.

nodes.name: diff-changes.css
nodes.summary: Styles the compact +/- diff stats readout with mono-font additions and deletions colored via diff add/delete text tokens, plus a bar-variant SVG mode.

nodes.name: dock-surface.css
nodes.summary: Styles dockable shell and tray surfaces with raised backgrounds, rounded corners, and overflow clipping, including attach-position-aware radius merging for top-attached trays.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a [data-dock-surface]/[data-dock-attach] attribute API instead of the usual data-component convention.

nodes.name: dropdown-menu.css
nodes.summary: Styles the dropdown menu with open/close animated content, items with labels/descriptions/indicators, separators, group labels, checkbox and radio items, sub-triggers, and arrow.

nodes.name: file-icon.css
nodes.summary: Styles the 16px file-type icon and filetree icon stacking: monochrome weak icons by default with original file-type colors on hover, and absolutely-positioned stacked icon pairs.

nodes.name: file.css
nodes.summary: Styles the file content viewer, enabling content-visibility auto for text mode and sticky diff-hunk separator line numbers for diff mode.
nodes.languageNotes: content-visibility: auto lets the browser skip rendering offscreen file content.

nodes.name: hover-card.css
nodes.summary: Styles the hover card popover with open/close animations and trigger/body slots for rich hover previews.

nodes.name: icon-button.css
nodes.summary: Styles the square icon-only button with size and variant handling, plus a pulsing stop-pulse animation for the stop action guarded by prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: icon.css
nodes.summary: Styles the inline icon wrapper with small/normal/medium/large size variants and a full-size SVG slot driven by the --icon-base color token.

nodes.name: image-preview.css
nodes.summary: Styles the image preview overlay with container, header, body, content, and image slots for full-size media viewing.
